data.desc: Beasley Broadcast Group, Inc. was founded in 1961 by George G. Beasley and owns a total of 49 AM and FM stations in 9 large- and mid-size markets in the United States. Beasley radio stations reach roughly 18 million unique consumers weekly over-the-air, online and on smartphones and tablets, and millions regularly engage with the Company's brands and personalities through digital platforms such as Facebook, X, text, apps and email.
